title: Rav Huna son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Rosh Hashanah 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.24b.4), saying: “I heard it from Abaye’s lecture.” Seder HaDorot wrote that the reading should be Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, as is implied in [Avodah Zarah 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.42b.2); and Hyman says that there, at [43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.43b.3), it became corrupted to Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua.[^1]

notes.text: Rosh Hashanah has Huna son of Idi hearing Abaye. Avodah Zarah 42b names Huna son of Yehoshua in another statement, while 43b has Yehudah son of Yehoshua hearing Rabbi Yehoshua in the parallel teaching. [Heilprin’s short notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=978&lang=en) proposes Huna son of Yehoshua and refers readers to [his fuller entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=966&lang=en).
